4.name: Bear Cubs and Broncos
4.overview: Tensions erupt when the two rival animal control precincts are forced to merge due to budget cuts; Frank and Templeton clash during a bear cub rescue as they fight for control; Emily and Shred try to hide their romance from the team.

4.name: Bagged Birds and Alley Dogs
4.overview: Frank spends the day with influencer and park benefactor Roman Park (Ken Jeong) ahead of the grand opening of their annex kennel. Friction arises within the newly combined precincts when Emily assigns Templeton, Shred and Patel to work together, while pairing Victoria with Daisy. Meanwhile, Emily and Shred find themselves in peculiar situations.

4.name: Dragons and Dognappers
4.overview: Rob Gronkowski returns and asks the team for help rehoming a Zebra. Emily and Shred's first date goes awry when they unexpectedly run into Daisy and Patel on their night out. Meanwhile, Frank must defend Templeton when Templeton is accused of dognapping.

4.name: Lost Dogs and Bar Flies
4.overview: Roman Park takes Frank's beloved dog away from him; in an effort to get his dog back, Frank and Shred find themselves on a late-night rescue mission; Patel's house sale spirals.

4.name: French Bulldogs and White Broncos
4.overview: Frank scrambles to find a last-minute date for a romantic sunset horse ride. Meanwhile, Patel hosts a "sip 'n snip" fundraising event which takes an unexpected turn when a prize-winning breeder dog is accidentally neutered.

4.name: Roosters and Moles
4.overview: When Templeton is nominated for Animal Control officer of the year, Frank sets out to rescue 24 animals in 24 hours. Victoria steps in for Shred after he's bitten by a kitten. Meanwhile, Templeton tries to sabotage Frank's mission.

4.name: Donkeys and Weasels
4.overview: Frank's dad temporarily moves into Frank's house following a heart attack. Meanwhile, Victoria and Patel try to find ways to replace pet food that was destroyed in a fire.

4.name: Squirrels and Fat Cats
4.overview: Frank uncovers Emily and Shred's secret romance during a break-in at city supply. Meanwhile, Victoria and Patel confront his daughter's school bully.

4.name: Bats and Camels
4.overview: Templeton and Frank compete for the endorsement of a legendary Animal Control officer in an effort to win Animal Control officer of the year. Meanwhile, Emily spirals when Shred goes on a date with Daisy's friend.

4.name: Scaredy Cats and Card Sharks
4.overview: When Frank and Daisy lose $5,000 in union funds, they try to win the money back by gambling. Meanwhile, Shred and Patel cover the late-night shift at the precinct.

4.name: Coyotes and Eagles
4.overview: A movie star (Oliver Hudson) shadows Frank for his upcoming role as an Animal Control officer. Meanwhile, Shred and Patel go on a juice cleanse and Emily forgets Templeton's birthday.

4.name: Golden Moose and Wiener Dogs
4.overview: The team arrives at the Animal Control Officer of the Year (ACOOTY) awards and party ahead of the ceremony. It's Frank vs. Templeton for the big prize, and Shred and Emily's secret romance is finally exposed when they are caught kissing.

5.name: Seahawks and Piglets
5.overview: Frank leads the team in a work stoppage, but abandons his cause for the ultimate call - recovering the Seahawks' missing mascot.

5.name: Crows and Lizard Legs
5.overview: Shred spirals when he discovers a negative online review about him that could reflect poorly on the precinct. Meanwhile, Patel, Victoria and Emily try to break up Addy's new relationship.

5.name: Bugs and Rabid Dogs
5.overview: Frank goes undercover at Roman's new privatized animal control company, Pax Romana.

5.name: Tortoises and Billy Goats
5.overview: When Emily's HR review threatens her reinstatement, Frank appoints himself her investigator.

5.name: Sled Dogs and Kitty Litter
5.overview: Victoria balances pig parenting with a hot date.

5.name: Baked Chickens and Rat Dogs
5.overview: Emily and Shred host their first party as a couple.

5.name: Stuffed Cats and Goslings
5.overview: The precinct hosts the annual Animal Control games and competes against the other precincts.

overview: A group of local animal control workers' lives are complicated by the fact that animals are simple, but humans are not. Leading the crew is Frank, an opinionated, eccentric animal control officer who may not have gone to college but is still the most well-read person in the room. In his past life as a cop, Frank tried to expose corruption in his department, but his efforts got him fired, leaving him cynical and curmudgeonly. Despite his rough exterior, he is blessed with an almost superhuman ability to understand animals.
